narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: tax is computed on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Suite is green: 625 passing, 0 failing.**

`orderTotal` in [src/pricing.js:39-43](src/pricing.js:39) taxed the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted one. Fixed it to tax `discounted` instead of `cents`. Only 3 cases were ever actually failing, the ones with both a discount and a tax rate.
